verdict.rationale: Browser Use ships as a Python library and CLI (installable via pip/uvx) plus a Cloud API (client.runs.create) that can be scripted entirely from code without a UI, and the MCP server install was verified to work keylessly in a throwaway venv — all consistent with CI/headless automation use. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a --headless flag or a CI/GitHub-Actions integration guide, and independent confirmation of running in a CI pipeline.
